places.name: North Platte River
places.note: The herd crosses it a little east of Ogallala, then swings northwest and beds down on the slopes north of the river.
places.location_hint: crossed just east of Ogallala, Nebraska

places.name: Ogallala
places.note: Six hands race in to carouse; Augustus buys Lorena clothes, finds a dull hotel, and knocks down a gambler who struck a young whore.
places.location_hint: small cluster of shacks and frame buildings near the Platte, visible from the slopes north of the river; five or six miles from the herd

places.name: Hat Creek herd camp near Ogallala
places.note: Call stays with the grazing herd; Lorena refuses to go to town and later sits crying by the tent, fearing Clara.
places.location_hint: on rolling slopes north of the Platte, about five or six miles from Ogallala, Nebraska

places.name: Brazos River
places.note: Augustus remembers coming back from scouts there with Jake and racing into Austin for a night out.

places.name: Austin
places.note: Where Augustus and Jake used to spend nights on whiskey, cards and women, irritating Clara and Call.

places.name: Montana
places.note: Augustus considers trailing straight on there without seeing Clara; he buys Lorena a warm coat for its cold weather.

places.name: Fort Worth
places.note: The last place Lorena could have seen herself in a mirror.

groups.label: Hat Creek outfit
groups.at: Hat Creek herd camp near Ogallala
groups.hint: bedded on slopes north of the Platte, five or six miles from Ogallala

groups.label: Hands in town
groups.hint: carousing in town for the night
